title: To Lower Case
description: Given a string s, return the string after replacing every uppercase letter with the same lowercase letter.
examples:
Example 1:

Input: s = "Hello"
Output: "hello"

Example 2:

Input: s = "here"
Output: "here"

Example 3:

Input: s = "LOVELY"
Output: "lovely"
constraints:
Constraints:

  • 1 <= s.length <= 100
  • s consists of printable ASCII characters.
